title: Compliance-first Private Launch: Release Orchestration & Customer Enablement Kit (RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate a compliance-first launch for Private/VPC/on-prem features (RBAC, audit logs, KMS/HSM integration). This ticket owns cross-team orchestration for: release notes (external and internal), customer enablement artifacts, legal/compliance sign-off language, sales/SE playbook, and the internal SRE/Support runbook required at GA. Focus is on minimizing customer migration risk, ensuring clear upgrade/migration instructions for existing Dedicated customers, and providing pre-approved compliance messaging for regulated verticals.
success_criteria: External release notes published on docs.redwood.ai with GA banner
Customer enablement kit (KB + runbook + RBAC templates + KMS migration guide) available in Drive and linked from Console release modal
Sales + SE enablement session completed and recording archived
Security & Legal have signed off on compliance wording and audit retention defaults
Support and SRE have runbook with escalation matrix and playbook for key failure modes
rollout_phases: Phase 0 — Internal alpha: docs preview, internal Q&A, targeted engineer preview (complete)
Phase 1 — Partner beta: 3 pilot customers, support on-call, collect migration feedback
Phase 2 — Gradual GA: opt-in customers, console toggle, telemetry monitoring
Phase 3 — Default GA: public release notes, API deprecation/migration announcements
deliverables: Customer-facing release notes (short + detailed technical section)
Enablement kit: presentation slides, demo script, 1-pager RBAC matrix
KMS migration guide and HSM integration checklist
Audit-logs SIEM mapping examples for Splunk/Datadog/Elastic
Support/SRE runbook: triage steps, rollback criteria, observability links
Console copy + in-app release modal content
Changelog entry and mailing list copy for account contacts
timeline: 2026-02-25: Draft release notes (v0) and RBAC templates delivered by PM
2026-03-10: Finalize enablement kit assets and SE playbook

release_notes_outline: Headline: What changed — high-level summary (1-2 sentences)
Why it matters: compliance and migration benefits for customers
Technical details: RBAC roles and scopes, audit log formats, KMS key lifecycle
Upgrade notes: steps for existing Dedicated customers and rollback guidance
Configuration examples: sample policies, API snippets, console screenshots
Security & compliance notes: default retention, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, KMS/HSM recommendations
Known limitations: feature parity gaps and planned follow-ups
Resources & contacts: links to KB, SE contact, and critical-support workflow
compliance_checklist: Confirm audit log retention defaults and configurable TTLs (Security)
Provide wording approved by Legal for regulated data handling
KMS/HSM: document supported providers, key rotation expectations, and BYOK guidance
RBAC: provide least-privilege role templates and mapping to common org structures
Data residency notes for Private deployments and VPC options
Logging: ensure presence of immutable audit trails and export hooks to SIEM
rollout_risks: Customers misconfigure RBAC and lose access to resources
KMS key migration may cause temporary unavailability if steps are not followed
Audit logs volume spikes could increase storage costs for customers
Legal/regulatory language delays could postpone public announcement
Support/SRE underprepared for combined failure modes across RBAC+KMS+audit
mitigation_actions: Create a pre-flight checklist for customers and an automated validation tool in Console
Require explicit backup/verification step in KMS migration guide
Add telemetry thresholds and cost alerts for audit-log ingestion; provide recommended retention settings
Run legal/security tabletop by 2026-03-03 and capture sign-off artifacts
Execute a simulated incident runbook with SRE and Support before partner beta
